source_title: Leeds United news: Tyler Adams' stay ruined by injury - Adam Pope - BBC
source_excerpt:
BBC Radio Leeds commentator Adam Pope has discussed Leeds' recent form with Ian Wilding ahead of Saturday's game at Bournemouth.
"Leeds are going well. There's no doubt about it, but there's a feeling just lately that they've let a few points go and that includes the Manchester United game and bottom of the table Sunderland," he said.
"The mitigating circumstances is that the first was a derby and they haven't been beaten by Manchester United in three games, and the elements were so inclement on Sunday at Sunderland that football was nigh impossible.
"So I think it's really hard to criticise Leeds for dropping points in those games.
"You don't want to be coming up against Bournemouth at the moment because the stats are frightening.
"Daniel Farke, he said that they are the form team, so I think we're in a situation where Leeds probably, if we're being realistic, could go in as you know less than favourites into this game definitely.
"[When]Tyler Adams [joined Leeds he] got injured and we never saw the best in Leeds plus he did leave for Bournemouth acrimoniously. It was really not a nice deal in the end the way it all went through.
"I think there is a bit of a bad taste and when he has played against Leeds United or been featured I think there's been a little bit of him trying to whip up the crowd a little bit as well.
"It hasn't surprised me that he's gone on to do OK. I think it was just injury really that stopped us seeing the best of him."
